environment.description: Same Celery worker deployed on ECS Fargate. Fronted by AWS API Gateway (REST API) with a request validator attached to the POST /reports method. The validator enforces a JSON Schema model named 'ReportRequestModel' on the request body. The schema defines 'expression' as type string with pattern '^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(\s*[\+\-\*\/]\s*[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)*$' (only simple arithmetic variable references), maxLength 64. The 'customer_name' field has pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9\s\-\.]{1,100}$'. The 'report_type' field is an enum of ['summary','invoice','analytics']. Request body validation is set to 'Validate body' mode with validateRequestBody=true. Requests failing schema validation receive 400 before reaching any backend. The API Gateway integration is VPC Link to internal ALB, no direct Redis/Celery access from internet.
